acceptanceCriteria: A ci:batched lane PR no longer has a failing go-product check solely because of the label
A ci:batched PR still cannot be merged alone without its tests running (test or recorded protection evidence)
The change goes through the ci-control-plane owner process for .github edits
body: Lane PRs labelled ci:batched (#1440 run 39623176355, #1441 run 39624280054, 2026-10-21) skip all go-product shards on purpose, but the go-product aggregate job then exits 1 with 'go-product shards did not run: this pull request is labelled ci:batched'. Each lane PR therefore shows a failing check, and the desktop Auto-fix monitor sends a CI-failure event for every lane PR, which an orchestrator has to inspect and dismiss by hand. Expected: an intentional batched skip reports neutral/skipped (or success with a notice), and the required-check protection still refuses a standalone merge of a batched PR by another route.
